Privacy Policy

Effective date: September 17, 2026

Quiz Run is published by Bohdan Zadorozhnyi (“he”, “him”, or “his”). This Privacy Policy explains how he handles information when you use the game on Android, iPhone, or iPad.

Information he collects

Quiz Run does not collect, transmit, sell, or share personal information.

The game does not use advertising, analytics, user accounts, social features, location, contacts, camera, microphone, or cross-app tracking.

Information stored on your device

Quiz Run stores game records and custom question packs locally on your device. This information is used only to provide the game’s features and is not transmitted to him or to third parties.

You can remove this local information by deleting the relevant custom question packs or uninstalling the game. Device or platform backup behavior is controlled by your operating-system settings.

Children’s privacy

Quiz Run does not knowingly collect personal information from children. The game has no accounts, advertising, purchases, chat, or user-to-user communication.

Third-party platforms

The app stores through which you download Quiz Run may process information under their own privacy policies. That processing is controlled by the relevant platform provider and is not part of Quiz Run’s in-app data collection.

Changes to this policy

If the game’s data practices change, he will update this policy and its effective date before releasing the relevant update.

Contact

For privacy or support questions, contact quizrun.support@gmail.com.
